sn22.64:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.64:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu …pe… pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.64:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti?
sn22.64:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante, maññamāno baddho mārassa,
sn22.64:2.9: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.64:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.64:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu, maññamāno baddho mārassa,
sn22.64:3.10: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo’ti. atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā …pe… bhagavantaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho …pe…
sn22.64:3.11: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
